profiles.shortDescription: BDF Industries designs and builds melting and forming systems for the glass industry. Its official range covers furnaces, forehearth equipment, forming machines, ware handling and process-control technologies.
fullDescription: BDF Industries is an Italian manufacturer of plants and equipment for glass-container production. Manufacturer-owned information documents engineering for both the melting and forming stages of the process.

The published product scope includes regenerative and recuperative furnaces, melting-furnace equipment, working ends and forehearths, IS forming machines, ware-handling equipment, variable equipment and process-control technologies. These facts support sourcing enquiries defined by a machine, system or technical specification.

profiles.shortDescription: Bignozzi manufactures hydraulic motors, planetary gear units, hydraulic presses and high-pressure pump components. Its official site also documents portable press equipment.
fullDescription: Bignozzi is an Italian mechanical-equipment manufacturer established in 1955 and based in Bondeno, Ferrara. The company presents five defined product lines on its own website.

The documented portfolio comprises seven-cylinder hydraulic motors, planetary gearboxes, hydraulic presses, pumps and components for high-pressure duties, and portable presses. Ventrovia uses these official product groups to review specification-led enquiries without extending the scope beyond the manufacturer's published range.

profiles.shortDescription: CIMA Motori designs and manufactures asynchronous electric motors. The official range includes single-phase, three-phase, efficiency-class, high-starting-torque, forced-ventilation and brake-motor configurations.
fullDescription: CIMA Motori is an Italian electric-motor brand whose official site records production from 1977 and identifies the operation with Nidec Global Appliance Europe. Its activity centres on the design and manufacture of asynchronous motors.

The published range covers single-phase and three-phase motors, IE2 and IE3 variants, high-starting-torque motors, forced-ventilation versions and motors fitted with brakes or decelerators. The manufacturer also documents custom designs for application-specific requirements.

profiles.shortDescription: Comer Industries develops power-transmission systems for mobile and industrial machinery. Its official portfolio covers axles, planetary drives, driveshafts, hydrostatic traction and electrified driveline solutions.
fullDescription: Comer Industries is an engineering group focused on mechanical, hydraulic and electric power-transmission solutions. The brand identity is verified through the company's official corporate and industrial-solution pages.

Published product areas include axles, planetary drives, tractor-attachment systems, driveshafts, hydrostatic traction, fan-clutch products and e-mobility systems. The industrial application scope documented by the manufacturer includes construction and forestry machines, marine and airport equipment, municipal machinery and renewable-energy systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Etatron develops chemical-dosing equipment and control systems. Its official product directory covers solenoid, motor-driven and peristaltic dosing pumps, controllers, regulating systems and accessories.
fullDescription: Etatron D.S. is an Italian manufacturer of dosing and water-treatment equipment whose official company material records activity from 1979. The verified product scope combines pumping hardware with measurement and control functions.

The manufacturer's published range includes solenoid-driven, motor-driven and peristaltic dosing pumps, controllers, control and regulating systems, and dosing accessories. These product groups support specification-led enquiries for chemical dosing, treatment and industrial process duties.

profiles.shortDescription: HELMKE supplies electric motors and complete drive systems for industrial duties. The official portfolio includes standard, slip-ring and explosion-protected motors plus application-specific modifications.
fullDescription: HELMKE is a German electric-motor and drive-system company whose official site records a history beginning in 1922. The manufacturer supports both standard configurations and engineered drive requirements.

Its documented product scope includes standard electric motors, slip-ring motors, explosion-protected motors and motor modifications for specific operating conditions. Ventrovia uses the exact motor or drive specification to structure a sourcing review.

profiles.shortDescription: Jungheinrich develops industrial trucks, warehouse equipment and intralogistics systems. Its official scope also covers automation, software, racking and lifecycle services for material-handling operations.
fullDescription: Jungheinrich is a German intralogistics company founded in 1953 and headquartered in Hamburg. Manufacturer-owned information presents an integrated range for warehouse and material-flow operations.

The documented portfolio includes industrial trucks, automated guided vehicles and mobile robots, automated warehouse systems, racking, warehouse equipment, software and digital solutions. The verified scope allows enquiries to be framed around the required truck, storage, automation or intralogistics function.

profiles.shortDescription: KÜENLE Antriebssysteme manufactures electric motors and geared-drive systems. The official range also covers frequency converters and custom drive developments.
fullDescription: KÜENLE Antriebssysteme is a German drive-technology manufacturer based in Hemmingen. The company publishes a focused product programme for industrial motor and geared-drive requirements.

Its documented scope includes electric motors, custom motor developments, frequency converters and geared motors. Published geared-drive types include helical, worm and bevel configurations, providing an official basis for model- and duty-specific sourcing enquiries.

profiles.shortDescription: Liebherr develops machinery and equipment for construction, material handling, mining and industrial production. The official portfolio also covers cranes, concrete technology, components, refrigeration and automation systems.
fullDescription: Liebherr is an industrial group with a manufacturer-owned product directory spanning heavy machinery, components and technical systems. The identity and scope are based on the group's official international website.

Published product segments include earthmoving and material-handling machinery, deep-foundation and mining equipment, concrete technology, tower, mobile and maritime cranes, gear technology and automation systems, aerospace and transportation systems, components, and refrigeration and freezing equipment. Enquiries should identify the relevant division, model and technical duty.
